	DBMS=XLSX
	OUT=WORK.IMPORT;
	GETNAMES=YES;
RUN;

PROC CONTENTS DATA=WORK.IMPORT; RUN;


%web_open_table(WORK.IMPORT);
/*====================================================================
  Binary classification metrics in SAS Studio
  Dependent variable  : Corn_Price_Up_5Pct (event = 1)
  Independent variables: Commercial_Position_Change Managed_Money_Position_Change Commercial_Pct_of_OI Managed_Money_Pct_of_OI
  Metrics: MCC, Accuracy, F1, Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision (PPV),
           NPV, Cohen's kappa, ROC AUC, Precision-Recall AUC
====================================================================*/

/*---- User settings ------------------------------------------------*/
%let cutoff = 0.5;           /* classification threshold if FIXED      */
%let cutoff_method = FIXED;  /* FIXED = use &cutoff ; YOUDEN = cutoff
                                that maximizes sensitivity+specificity-1 */

ods graphics on;

/*---- 1. Logistic model, with outputs added -------------------*/
proc logistic data=WORK.IMPORT plots(only)=roc;
	model Corn_Price_Up_5Pct(event='1')=Commercial_Position_Change Managed_Money_Position_Change Commercial_Pct_of_OI Managed_Money_Pct_of_OI / link=logit 
		technique=fisher
		outroc=work.rocdata;
	output out=work.scored predicted=phat;
	ods output Association=work.assoc;
run;

/*---- 2. Keep only observations actually scored --------------------*/
data work.scored2;
	set work.scored;
	where not missing(phat) and not missing(Corn_Price_Up_5Pct);
	y = (Corn_Price_Up_5Pct = 1);
run;

/*---- 3. Optional Youden-optimal cutoff ----------------------------*/
data _null_;
	set work.rocdata end=last;
	retain best -1 bestp .;
	j = _sensit_ - _1mspec_;
	if j > best then do;
		best = j;
		bestp = _prob_;
	end;
	if last and upcase("&cutoff_method") = 'YOUDEN' then
		call symputx('cutoff', bestp);
run;

%put NOTE: Classification cutoff used = &cutoff;

/*---- 4. Confusion matrix counts -----------------------------------*/
proc sql noprint;
	select sum(y=1 and phat>=&cutoff),
	       sum(y=0 and phat>=&cutoff),
	       sum(y=0 and phat<&cutoff),
	       sum(y=1 and phat<&cutoff),
	       sum(y=1),
	       sum(y=0)
	into :TP trimmed, :FP trimmed, :TN trimmed, :FN trimmed,
	     :NPOS trimmed, :NNEG trimmed
	from work.scored2;
quit;

/*---- 5. AUC of ROC (c statistic from PROC LOGISTIC) ---------------*/
proc sql noprint;
	select nValue2 into :auc_roc trimmed
	from work.assoc
	where Label2 = 'c';
quit;

/*---- 6. Precision-Recall curve and its AUC ------------------------*/
proc sql;
	create table work.byprob as
	select phat, sum(y=1) as pos, sum(y=0) as neg
	from work.scored2
	group by phat
	order by phat desc;
quit;

data work.pr;
	set work.byprob end=last;
	retain tp_c 0 fp_c 0 prev_recall 0 prev_prec . ap 0 auc_pr_trap 0;
	tp_c + pos;
	fp_c + neg;
	precision = tp_c / (tp_c + fp_c);
	recall    = tp_c / &NPOS;
	if _n_ = 1 then prev_prec = precision;
	ap          + (recall - prev_recall) * precision;                       /* step-wise (average precision) */
	auc_pr_trap + (recall - prev_recall) * (precision + prev_prec) / 2;     /* trapezoidal */
	prev_recall = recall;
	prev_prec   = precision;
	if last then do;
		call symputx('auc_pr_ap',   ap);
		call symputx('auc_pr_trap', auc_pr_trap);
	end;
run;

/*---- 7. Threshold-based metrics -----------------------------------*/
data work.metrics;
	TP = &TP; FP = &FP; TN = &TN; FN = &FN;
	N  = TP + FP + TN + FN;
	Cutoff = &cutoff;

	Accuracy    = (TP + TN) / N;
	Sensitivity = ifn((TP+FN)>0, TP / (TP + FN), .);
	Specificity = ifn((TN+FP)>0, TN / (TN + FP), .);
	Precision   = ifn((TP+FP)>0, TP / (TP + FP), .);
	NPV         = ifn((TN+FN)>0, TN / (TN + FN), .);
	F1          = ifn((2*TP+FP+FN)>0, 2*TP / (2*TP + FP + FN), .);

	denom = sqrt((TP+FP) * (TP+FN) * (TN+FP) * (TN+FN));
	MCC   = ifn(denom>0, (TP*TN - FP*FN) / denom, 0);

	po = (TP + TN) / N;
	pe = ((TP+FP)*(TP+FN) + (FN+TN)*(FP+TN)) / (N*N);
	Cohens_Kappa = ifn(pe<1, (po - pe) / (1 - pe), .);

	AUC_ROC           = &auc_roc;
	AUC_PR_AvgPrec    = &auc_pr_ap;
	AUC_PR_Trapezoid  = &auc_pr_trap;

	drop denom po pe;
run;

/*---- 8. Report ----------------------------------------------------*/
title "Confusion Matrix Counts (cutoff = &cutoff)";
proc print data=work.metrics noobs;
	var N TP FP TN FN;
run;

title "Classification Performance: Corn_Price_Up_5Pct ~ four predictors (multivariate)";
proc print data=work.metrics noobs;
	var Cutoff Accuracy Sensitivity Specificity Precision NPV F1 MCC
	    Cohens_Kappa AUC_ROC AUC_PR_AvgPrec AUC_PR_Trapezoid;
	format Accuracy Sensitivity Specificity Precision NPV F1 MCC
	       Cohens_Kappa AUC_ROC AUC_PR_AvgPrec AUC_PR_Trapezoid 6.4;
run;

/*---- 9. Plots -----------------------------------------------------*/
title "Precision-Recall Curve";
proc sgplot data=work.pr;
	series x=recall y=precision / markers;
	refline %sysevalf(&NPOS/(&NPOS+&NNEG)) / axis=y lineattrs=(pattern=dash)
		label="No-skill (prevalence)";
	xaxis label="Recall (Sensitivity)" min=0 max=1;
	yaxis label="Precision (PPV)" min=0 max=1;
run;

title "ROC Curve";
proc sgplot data=work.rocdata;
	series x=_1mspec_ y=_sensit_;
	lineparm x=0 y=0 slope=1 / lineattrs=(pattern=dash);
	xaxis label="1 - Specificity" min=0 max=1;
	yaxis label="Sensitivity" min=0 max=1;
run;

title;
